microtheory.name: embodied_cognition_foundation
microtheory.definition: Embodied + situated + extended + enactive cognition. The mind is not just brain — it's brain + body + environment in dynamic coupling. Varela + Thompson + Rosch (Embodied Mind 1991), Clark + Chalmers (Extended Mind 1998), Gibson (Ecological Psychology 1979), Lakoff + Johnson (conceptual metaphor grounded in body). Substrate analogue: substrate's babble-as-grounding principle is foundational embodied cognition.

concepts.name: embodiment
concepts.definition: Cognition shaped by body. Body isn't just executor of mind's commands — it constrains + enables + structures cognition. Substrate analogue: substrate's structural-graph as embodiment.

concepts.name: situatedness
concepts.definition: Cognition shaped by immediate environment. Same agent thinks differently in different contexts. Substrate analogue: substrate's per-environment-state Mt activation.

concepts.name: extended_mind
concepts.definition: Clark + Chalmers 1998. Mind extends into tools when tools play same functional role as internal states. Substrate analogue: substrate's tool-using extension.

concepts.name: enactivism
concepts.definition: Varela + Thompson + Rosch 1991. Cognition is action — not representation of pre-given world but enactment of a world. Substrate analogue: substrate's grounding-by-action.

concepts.name: 4e_cognition
concepts.definition: Embodied + embedded + extended + enacted. Umbrella for post-cognitivist approaches. Substrate analogue: substrate's whole post-classical-cognition framework.

concepts.name: perception_action_loop
concepts.definition: Perception drives action drives perception. Tight coupling. No clear input-process-output separation. Substrate analogue: substrate's babble-loop.

concepts.name: sensorimotor_contingency
concepts.definition: O'Regan + Noë 2001. Perception is mastery of sensorimotor contingencies — knowing how sensory input changes with action. Substrate analogue: substrate's action-outcome learning.

concepts.name: active_perception
concepts.definition: Perception requires action. Active sensing. Substrate analogue: substrate's exploration-driven sensing.

concepts.name: body_schema
concepts.definition: Implicit pre-reflective model of body. Updates with action + tool use. Distinct from body image. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-state model.

concepts.name: body_image
concepts.definition: Explicit conceptual body representation. Substrate analogue: substrate's explicit self-Concept.

concepts.name: proprioception
concepts.definition: Sense of body position + movement. Joint receptors, muscle spindles. Substrate analogue: substrate's internal-state monitoring.

concepts.name: kinesthesia
concepts.definition: Sense of body movement. Sometimes used interchangeably with proprioception. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-change sensing.

concepts.name: interoception
concepts.definition: Sense of internal body states. Hunger, thirst, pain, heartbeat. Damasio. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-state awareness.

concepts.name: ecological_psychology
concepts.definition: Gibson 1979. Direct perception of affordances. Information IN environment, not constructed from impoverished input. Substrate analogue: substrate's direct-affordance approach.

concepts.name: affordance
concepts.definition: Gibson. Action possibility an environment offers. Chair affords sitting. Substrate analogue: substrate's environment-action coupling.

concepts.name: optical_array
concepts.definition: Gibson. Structured light reaching an observer. Information-rich. Substrate analogue: substrate's full input pattern.

concepts.name: ecological_information
concepts.definition: Information specifying perceiver-environment relations. Picked up directly. Substrate analogue: substrate's relation-specifying input.

concepts.name: tool_use_embodied
concepts.definition: Tools extend body schema. Maravita + Iriki 2004. Tools become part of self. Substrate analogue: substrate's tool incorporation.

concepts.name: rubber_hand_illusion
concepts.definition: Botvinick + Cohen 1998. Stroking rubber hand + own hidden hand synchronously makes rubber feel like own. Body schema is plastic. Substrate analogue: substrate's incorporation flexibility.

concepts.name: mirror_neurons_embodied
concepts.definition: Neurons firing for action + observation of action. Rizzolatti. Foundation of action understanding via simulation. Substrate analogue: substrate's babble-loop self-imitation.

concepts.name: embodied_simulation
concepts.definition: Gallese. Understanding others by simulating their states in own sensorimotor system. Substrate analogue: substrate's substrate-state simulation.

concepts.name: conceptual_metaphor_embodied
concepts.definition: Lakoff + Johnson 1980, 1999. Abstract concepts structured by mappings from sensorimotor domains. ARGUMENT IS WAR. Substrate analogue: substrate's analogical-grounding.

concepts.name: image_schema_embodied
concepts.definition: Johnson 1987. Pre-conceptual sensorimotor patterns (container, path, force, balance) underlying meaning. Substrate analogue: substrate's primitive grounding-schemas.

concepts.name: primary_metaphor
concepts.definition: Grady. Universal cross-cultural metaphors with sensorimotor origin. MORE IS UP, AFFECTION IS WARMTH. Substrate analogue: substrate's universal-grounding metaphors.

concepts.name: morphological_computation
concepts.definition: Pfeifer + Bongard. Body shape does computation that brain doesn't have to. Passive dynamic walking. Substrate analogue: substrate's structure-doing-computation.

concepts.name: embodied_robotics
concepts.definition: Brooks 1990 subsumption architecture. Behavior emerges from body + environment interaction, not central planner. Substrate analogue: substrate's emergent behavior.

concepts.name: infant_motor_development
concepts.definition: Thelen + Smith 1994. Motor development as dynamic systems process, not maturation of fixed program. Substrate analogue: substrate's developmental embodiment.

concepts.name: dynamic_systems_cognition
concepts.definition: Cognition as continuous dynamics in agent-environment system. Substrate analogue: substrate's continuous Mt-state evolution.

rules.name: cognition_requires_body_environment_coupling
rules.head: the substrate processes cognition
rules.body: the processing cannot be understood without reference to body + environment coupling. 4E principle. Substrate's embodied + situated nature.

rules.name: perception_is_action_oriented
rules.head: the substrate perceives the world
rules.body: the perception is shaped by + for action — affordances, sensorimotor contingencies. Substrate's action-oriented perception.

rules.name: body_schema_is_plastic
rules.head: the substrate uses a tool repeatedly
rules.body: the body schema extends to incorporate the tool. Maravita + Iriki. Substrate's tool-incorporation flexibility.

rules.name: conceptual_metaphor_grounds_abstract_in_sensorimotor
rules.head: the substrate handles abstract concepts
rules.body: their structure comes from sensorimotor metaphors. Lakoff + Johnson. Substrate's analogical grounding.

rules.name: morphology_offloads_brain_computation
rules.head: the substrate has structural-graph form fitting tasks
rules.body: the structure performs computation the cortex doesn't have to. Pfeifer + Bongard. Substrate's structural computation.
